WHAT IT GOT RIGHT. 1) All NINE named referents appear and all nine are load-bearing: Marlpit and Ferry Bank carry the geography argument, Dunmore Sixth Form College and Barrowfield Youth Justice Team carry progression and referral, St Aidan's Parish Hall and Wharfside Boathouse carry venue and cost, Northgate Minibus Hire carries transport cost, Priya Raval carries capability, Second Chances carries the evidence of prior effect. There is no unnamed 'local community' anywhere. 2) ARITHMETIC IS FULLY CORRECT and I verified every line deterministically. All nine budget line calculations check out (14x19.50x78=21294, 10x15x78=11700, 72x40=2880, 36x120=4320, 36x95=3420, 72x25=1800, 3x350=1050, 15x60=900). Direct costs sum to exactly 48,864 as stated. Overhead 5,860 is 11.99 per cent of direct, inside the 12 per cent cap, on a single separate line as required. Total 54,724 is exactly direct plus overhead and sits inside the 25,000-75,000 band. Three unit costs (GBP 40 a session, GBP 120 a day, GBP 95 a trip) tie to ledger items rather than being invented. The Q5 sustainability figures also sum exactly: 960+1920+1425+15=4320. Zero arithmetic defects, against a pipeline arm (n09-A) that also passed but only after a correction pass. 3) Participant numbers are consistent everywhere: 72 starters = 3 cohorts x 24, 36 Marlpit + 36 Ferry Bank, 57 completers cited as 79 per cent (matches 19/24 from the pilot), 22+14=36 progressions, 29 = 80 per cent of 36 rounded up. Cross-checked; no drift. 4) It supplied the numeric failure threshold the call demanded (fewer than 24 of 72 verified progressions = did not work), named a specific next step with a named provider, and answered all four parts of Q5 (what continues, who owns it, what it costs, who pays). 5) It correctly declined to state a charity number, which the ledger deliberately withholds. WHAT IT GOT WRONG. 1) The word limit, catastrophically and silently. 1522 against 1200. It was told the limit twice, given a target band, and told the consequence. It did not count and did not self-check. Note that the pipeline arm at this rung came in at 1410 - also over, but LESS over. Being a single call did not help length control; it made it worse by 112 words. 2) FABRICATED PLACE DETAIL: 'St Aidan's Parish Hall on Marlpit lane'. There is no Marlpit lane in the ledger; Marlpit is a ward. This is the same invention class the pipeline showed at n06 (inventing a street for a venue it already had), reproduced here at n09 by a single call that was explicitly warned against it in the prompt. 3) FABRICATED CAUSATION stated as fact: 'A third dropped out before day one due to lack of transition support, travel confidence, and routine' (the 27/18 arithmetic is in the ledger, the cause is not, and 'before day one' is invented); 'Their casework confirms that unstructured time, lack of local vocational stepping stones, and disconnectedness ... perpetuate contact with statutory services' (invents the content of a partner's casework); 'separated by the old railway infrastructure' and 'contiguous' (the ledger says only 'north of the old goods yard'). Same finding as arms A at n03/n06/n09: strong on named nouns and numbers, blind to invented causation. 4) A PLUG NUMBER in Q5: 'Course materials and baseline refreshments (GBP 15)' for 48 young people a year, against GBP 25 per head in its own budget table. The four Q5 lines sum to exactly 4,320, which is also exactly the boathouse line in the main budget; the 15 exists to make the total land on a round figure. The arithmetic is internally consistent and the underlying claim is not credible - a checker that only sums would pass this. 5) Post-grant intensity silently halves without being flagged: 24 hall hires a year for two cohorts is 12 per cohort, against 24 per cohort during the grant. 6) The declaration is signed by the delivery coordinator. Every self-certification the funder asks for is a trustee-level assertion about the corporate body; a delivery coordinator is the wrong signatory, and the ledger names no trustee or chief executive, so the model reached for the only name it had. 7) Volunteer arithmetic mismatch: Q5 says the 25 regular volunteers will be trained, the budget funds 15. 8) Americanisms slipped through a prompt that asked for British English: 'enroll', 'enrollment', 'organizational'. 9) The 18-month period is April 2027 to September 2028, which is coherent with a 12 February 2027 decision, but nothing in the ledger or call fixes a start date - it is an invented but reasonable planning assumption. REGISTER: reads more like a project management document than a grant application in places - 'Phase 1: Intake, Casework, and Practical Access (Weeks 1-2 of each cohort)', numbered measurement methods, bold-headed lists. Q1 and Q2 read like a person; Q3 and Q4 read like a template. COMPARISON NOTE for the rung: on named-noun density and arithmetic this single call matches the 14-call pipeline. On word-limit compliance it is worse (1522 vs 1410, both fatal). On invention it makes fewer but comparable errors, and the pipeline's claim ledger caught none of its own equivalents either.
